presets.name: THE MACHINES KEPT WORKING
presets.note: A steady industrial process that gradually organises itself. Hold the root; raise LIFE and watch STRUCTURE begin to answer MASS.

presets.name: A CITY WITHOUT WITNESSES
presets.note: Distant structures, air, rare resonant movement. Nothing here wants attention; leave it running under a scene.

presets.name: THE LAST HUMAN FREQUENCY
presets.note: A fragile formant survives inside hostile spectra. HUMANITY pulls the voice forward; VIOLENCE lets the machines have it.

presets.name: BENEATH THIRTY KILOMETRES OF CONCRETE
presets.note: Coherent sub pressure with immense upper resonances. The sub is the anchor; everything else is the weight above it.

presets.name: NO ONE ANSWERS THE BROADCAST
presets.note: Repeated synthetic messages degrade into fragments. Run HISTORY over ten minutes and let EROSION take the signal apart.

presets.name: AN INTELLIGENCE IN THE WALLS
presets.note: Localised pulses develop coordinated responses. The event lanes are the intelligence; COUPLING is how much it listens.

presets.name: THE SEA IS MADE OF IRON
presets.note: Broad metallic motion with a slow physical undertow. A bowed plate over a sub; the bow speed breathes.

presets.name: WE WERE PROMISED A FUTURE
presets.note: A mournful chord becomes mechanically constrained. Play it as a pad; the scenes take it into the machine.

presets.name: POPULATION: ZERO
presets.note: Almost silence, distance, and rare signs of operation. Turn it up; the quiet is the point.

presets.name: SOMETHING LEARNED TO BREATHE
presets.note: Asymmetric, adapting pulses emerge from noise. The shape envelope is the breath; the network decides how deep.

presets.name: ORBITAL DEBRIS CHOIR
presets.note: Slowly moving inharmonic tones over a restrained tonal anchor. The fundamental holds while the rest drifts out of tune.

presets.name: THE FACTORY DREAMED OF FLESH
presets.note: Industrial resonances acquire vulnerable formants. HUMANITY is the dream; at zero it is only the factory.

presets.name: AFTER THE FINAL TRANSMISSION
presets.note: A short source leaves a long, evolving residue. Strike once (a key, or STRIKE) and listen to the loop take it.

presets.name: THE SUN BEHIND THE ASH
presets.note: Softness and obscured harmonic light. HUMANITY lifts the ash a little; nothing here is loud.

presets.name: A WEAPON WAITING FOR A WAR
presets.note: Contained energy, repetition, an abrupt controlled release. LFO 1 gates the pulse; VIOLENCE is the trigger.

presets.name: THIRTY THOUSAND YEARS
presets.note: The flagship journey: order, occupation, collapse, altered life. Switch HISTORY on, set it to thirty minutes, and leave.

presets.name: CONCRETE BASS
presets.note: A dry, playable sub bass with a ladder growl. Mono, legato, no space.

presets.name: IRON BASS
presets.note: A bass whose body is a struck cable. Velocity is the hammer.

presets.name: CABLE BASS
presets.note: A bowed cable under a sine. Slow attack, long sustain; aftertouch presses the bow.

presets.name: STEEL CATHEDRAL
presets.note: A plate the size of a building, bowed slowly. Everything is resonance.

presets.name: HOSTILE COMPUTATION
presets.note: Stepped tables through PM, clocked events resetting the signal. A machine thinking out loud.

presets.name: SIRENS OVER THE DISTRICT
presets.note: Siren tables sweeping through a shifter, far away. DISTANCE brings them over the rooftops.

presets.name: GRANITE PAD
presets.note: A dry, wide chord pad with no space at all. Sits under drums.

presets.name: THE ROOM IS LISTENING
presets.note: Every note strikes a glass body and the loop keeps it. Play sparsely.

presets.name: COLD START
presets.note: The naked MASS oscillators, no filter movement, no space. A starting point.

presets.name: NAKED SIGNAL
presets.note: Only the SIGNAL tables, clean. For building.

presets.name: NAKED STRUCTURE
presets.note: A struck plate and nothing else. For learning the body controls.

presets.name: NAKED MEMORY
presets.note: The voice source through grains, dry. Import your own material here.

presets.name: ABANDONED SUBSTATION
presets.note: A mains hum with harmonics, a transformer body, and the loop keeping it warm.

presets.name: THE ARCHIVE BURNS
presets.note: The choir memory frozen and slowly displaced while the crusher eats it. Ten minutes of HISTORY.

presets.name: STRESSED PLATE
presets.note: A plate under rising stress: strike it and it fractures. STRESS on the macro VIOLENCE.

presets.name: BREATH OF THE GRID
presets.note: A synced square gate over a sub drone and a cavity. Tempo-locked.

presets.name: VOICES UNDER THE ICE
presets.note: The voice source, spectral, frozen and smeared, under a sine. Distant and slow.

presets.name: SLOW COLLAPSE
presets.note: Everything present, sinking. HISTORY from a clean chord to rubble in four minutes.

presets.name: HOLLOW EARTH
presets.note: Hollow tables in a cavity, low. The kind of note a mountain would hold.

presets.name: LAST LIGHT IN THE TOWER
presets.note: A single fragile sine tower, glass modes, and a shifter breathing at half a hertz.

presets.name: COOLING TOWERS
presets.note: Concrete cylinders breathing. A cavity over a sub, the cutoff drifting on a slow sine, wide.

presets.name: SERVO BASS
presets.note: A machine-table bass with a snapping filter and a comb in the lane. Mono.

presets.name: GLASS RAIN
presets.note: Noise bursts on glass modes, scattered by an event lane, in a large space.

presets.name: TELEMETRY
presets.note: Stepped tables on a synced sample-and-hold, crushed, with a siren far behind.

presets.name: THE DEEP FIELD
presets.note: Slightly inharmonic partials rising very slowly, very far away.

presets.name: FURNACE
presets.note: Heat rising through a beam. The scenes stoke it; VIOLENCE opens the door.

presets.name: PLATE TECTONICS
presets.note: A plate bowed so slowly it creaks; the stress builds until it gives.

presets.name: RADIO SILENCE
presets.note: The broadcast, frozen by an event lane and shifted a few hertz, thins to nothing.

presets.name: MONOLITH
presets.note: One enormous square sub with its harmonics reinforced and a hollow table above it. Nothing moves.

presets.name: SWARM
presets.note: Organism tables through phase-modulation feedback, a random walk on the pitch, choir grains, the network wide awake.

presets.name: THIN AIR
presets.note: A sine and a triangle, slowly, and nothing else at all. The quiet tone.

presets.name: THE LAST GENERATOR
presets.note: A square gate over a machine table and a sub, a tape delay behind, the loop feeding the structure.
